meta.description: Joins multiple paths or geometries into one list, for example to add roots to a plant or to give an instance node several leaves to pick from

a.description: Paths, geometry or instances, they come first in the list.

b.description: More paths, geometry or instances, after those of a.

c.description: More paths, geometry or instances, after those of b.

d.description: More paths, geometry or instances, after those of c.
